name: fld_sum_pow_finite_field
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : ∑ x : K, x ^ k = if (Fintype.card K - 1) ∣ k then (-1 : K) else 0
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), ∑ x : K, x ^ k = if (Fintype.card K - 1) ∣ k then (-1 : K) else 0
informal: Complete power-sum formula over a finite field F_q: for k > 0, the sum of x^k over all x is -1 if (q-1) | k and 0 otherwise — since k > 0 the term x = 0 contributes 0, so the sum equals the sum over units, which is FiniteField.sum_pow_units.
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype K] (k : ℕ), 0 < k → ∑ x, x ^ k = if Fintype.card K - 1 ∣ k then -1 else 0
